about: The workspace reachability register of PFS-2140.011: every public capability the guard tests/tier1_offline/test_p0400_reach_guard.py finds unreached from the workspace entry points, each expressly identified. A row is deleted when its capability becomes reached; the register only shrinks.
limit: Reached means a static reference path from a workspace entry point, not an observed execution: a reached class reaches all its methods (public methods are not inventoried on their own), a registry entry is reached with its registry even when a runtime check refuses it, and a branch decided at run time counts both ways. Annotations, TYPE_CHECKING and constant-false branches and code after an unconditional exit do not count. The guard's module docstring states the full list.

reasons.routed later: a planning node routes the capability to the workspace, or removes it, at the release named; the row expires at that release
reasons.maintainer or developer API: maintainer or developer API, outside the workspace rule by the decision named
reasons.Python-only by design: Python-only by design, by the decision named
